package.name: prove_fusion
package.description: PROVE Autonomy camera + LiDAR fusion for Isaac Sim on a Jetson Orin Nano. Subscribes to 3 camera streams + 1 LiDAR, runs per-camera 2D detection, performs frustum-based camera-LiDAR fusion to produce accurate 3D object boxes with distances, detects lane lines classically and projects them onto the LiDAR ground plane, and publishes everything as a labeled point cloud + MarkerArray for RViz2 visualization.
